reference_preprocess: Original load_img_and_K(BytesIO(PNG),size=None,K=None,device=cpu) then transform_img_and_K(x,(576,576),mode=crop,K=None): FP32 area interpolation, native640x480 ->768x576, center crop left96/top0. Known [-1,1] output converts with (x+1)/2, clips[0,1], multiplies255 and truncates uint8; preserve transformed uint8 references. No PIL resampling or image alignment.
prediction_emission: Use original tensor_to_pil-emitted targets_uint8; independently verify from targets_fp32: transpose CHW toHWC, if min<-0.1 use (x+1)/2 else unchanged; multiply255 then clip[0,255] and truncate uint8. Preserve perframe branch/min/max; do not replace with unconditional normalization.
primary_metric: For each full4x576x576x3 normalized uint8 pair: cast each to float64, divide by255, mean squared difference; primary L is arithmetic mean of4 complete frame MSEs. No ROI, validity mask, alignment, exposure correction or selection.
signed_comparison: delta_B_minus_A0=L(B)-L(A0); positive supports lower emitted-RGB error for A0 in this fixed case; negative supports B. Zero means equal on this metric. No significance/generalization inference.
secondary_metrics: A0/A1 and A0/B emitted-image pixel MSE as output-difference diagnostics
exact_zero_psnr_json: string Infinity, with MSE retained as0; do not drop frame
replay_rule: Exact shape/dtype and C-order bytes for all8_latents.npy plus all4 targets_fp32.npy; check emitted uint8 too. One repeat is not a variance estimate. Failed replay means no context-effect attribution, even when descriptive scores exist.
prediction_direction: Exploratory old higher-support A0 is expected to reduce reference error versus B; require complete fixed evidence and positive delta_B_minus_A0. No result-driven threshold, seed, target or arm replacement; a nonpositive delta ends this fixed-case support-to-emitted-RGB-benefit motivation. Positive delta alone is not a geometric mechanism or novel method.
reference_access_order: Generation and independent generation-result verification precede scoring access; targets are historically seen and GT cameras used, never claim blind/online test.
output: scoring_01/receipt.json plus transformed_targets_uint8.npy and per-target PNGs; create-only, preserve failures
limits: one known short sequence and4 correlated targets;2 A executions are repeats, not independent samples
approximate intrinsics, no extra undistortion and RGB-time pose interpolation
A/B changes full ordered context, camera normalization, latent slots, embedding and guidance descendants; not isolated scale/content/retrieval
pixel error rewards some blurring and does not establish perceptual quality, geometry, long-horizon consistency or algorithm novelty
